caption: Overview of the proposed method. It is illustrated with the Cockcroft-Gault creatinine-clearance calculator. The workflow retrieves and structures calculator rules, synthesizes and validates an executable calculator tool, extracts calculator inputs from a patient note, and executes the validated tool deterministically.
